gastronomie/alchimie[0].facts: The original 2014 recipe uses pastry sheets, milk, sugar and vanilla cream. Flour and water make dough; dough sheets with vanilla cream identify Cremșnit.
gastronomie/alchimie[0].player_arc: Make Aluat and Cremă de vanilie separately, then assemble the pastry.
gastronomie/alchimie[0].limits: Alchimie is pair-association crafting: the five visible ingredients are not a complete literal recipe. Milk+sugar and sugar+vanilla are associative cream openings, not sufficient cooking instructions.

viata_de_roman/conexiuni[0].facts: The four quads use membership/function predicates: geometry-kit instruments; floor-cleaning implements; water-connected sanitary fittings; gardening implements.
viata_de_roman/conexiuni[0].crossfit_walk: No writing instruments share this board. Rake and broom both collect debris, but the ordinary domestic-floor tools are broom/dustpan/mop/vacuum; rake is a garden implement for soil/plant debris. A watering can is mobile, not connected to the plumbing. Robinet is a plumbing fitting rather than a garden implement.
viata_de_roman/conexiuni[0].difficulty: Easy functional classification. The geometry group relies on recognizing a familiar school kit; it does not claim all four tools are graduated.

viata_de_roman/conexiuni[1].facts: Electrical circuit components; manually operated workshop tools; furniture designed for sitting; vessels for hot cooking. All16 tiles are concepts.
viata_de_roman/conexiuni[1].crossfit_walk: Hand tools may have electrical variants, but the graph nodes and quartet denote the ordinary manual tool senses. Cooking vessels are not seating furniture. Oală/Cratiță/Tigaie have neighboring everyday senses, but they intentionally remain in the same group. No electrical appliance is displayed outside the circuit-components group.
viata_de_roman/conexiuni[1].difficulty: Easy functional classification. Recognizing a circuit component versus a device is the most specific category.

additional_lant_suggestion.role: Held after root challenge: credible branches converge on milk/cream; broad kitchen/fridge route is insufficient independent branch quality. No import.
additional_lant_suggestion.limits: Milk→cream and cream→Cremșnit are specific; the alternate Cozonac→Bucătărie→Frigider route is broader. Do not count as a delivered round.

held_diplomat_history.facts: Qualified sweet whipping cream replaces the old explicitly fermented Smântână input. Its truthful direct ingredient edge and the Portocală edge make this exact seed set a one-action target.
held_diplomat_history.player_arc: The original apparent two-action arc is invalid after the necessary graph truth correction.
held_diplomat_history.limits: The raw record remains for complete independent rejection coverage, not promotion. Six alternative seed frames expose unused seeds, double-cream routes or weak tool/sugar-only output; no variant is forwarded.
